name: Voyage-3-Lite
notes:
Voyage AI is a closed API with no published weights and therefore no config.json. The KV-geometry fields are left null and the record stays a vendor-context row rather than an architecture row. DRAFT — architecture details not verifiable. No config.json on HuggingFace. Vendor claims 512 dimensions and 32k context for voyage-3-lite, but these are not verified from config. Not open weights — available via Voyage API and AWS SageMaker. Treat all architecture fields as unverified.

CONTEXT_SCALING_METHOD (null): proprietary API, no config and no published context-extension method; nothing to classify. KV CACHE FIELD CORRECTED (2026-10-05): kv_cache_bytes_per_token was 0.0, which contradicted this record's own prose - the note said the KV-geometry fields are 'left null' because there is no published config to read, and the field said 0. The prose was right and the field was wrong. Zero is a CLAIM: it asserts that the model provably has no per-token KV cache, which is exactly what an unreadable closed-API architecture cannot tell you. These are embedding models over a fixed-length input, so the cache is almost certainly irrelevant, but 'almost certainly from a vendor context row' is not the same epistemic status as 'verified from config', and this repo's convention is that null means the field was not established. A reader querying for models with no KV cache would otherwise pick these up alongside genuine encoders like bge-base-en-v1-5 and Mamba models, which ARE verified. Field is now null, matching the note. See gotcha mdl-gotcha-kv-zero-means-three-different-things. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card publishes no table for these rows, so they are unsourced. voyage-code-3 card has MTEB tables but not this 8-domain NDCG@10 metric for voyage-3-lite. RE-REVIEWED 2026-10-21: the card DOES publish these numbers - card model-index value 72.9743... rounds to the record's 72.98 (NDCG@10, 8 domains). An automated first pass called this no_table because the table was HTML or a model-index YAML rather than a markdown pipe table. BENCHMARK GAP FILLED 2026-10-23: 10 rows added from the card that the record was missing (was 1 rows). Vendor-published; the numbers were checked to appear in the card text.
